_comment: ELM-FATES_template. Copy this folder when creating a new ELM-FATES case, then replace this comment with the case's own description. Holds per-parameter knowledge for this case: bounds actually used, cautions, measured responses. A DICT keyed by parameter name, NOT a list: MemoryManager indexes it by name (manager.py:736-739) and iterates it with .items() (manager.py:285 and :366). It shipped as a list until 2026-09-08, which made every case scaffolded from this template fail on the first parameter-knowledge write (TypeError: list indices must be integers) and on get_parameter_cautions (AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'items'), the latter called by every diagnosis.
_scope: SITE-SPECIFIC / CASE-SPECIFIC knowledge only. Knowledge true of the MODEL wherever it runs belongs in memory/<model>/gained_knowledge/, and promotion up to that layer is a separate, later, evidence-gated decision -- one case showing a relation is one observation. Relationships in the model SOURCE CODE belong in neither store: they are the model knowledge graph, which is built by reading source and is independent of any case and any target.
_source: Template scaffold created 2026-09-08. EMPTY BY DESIGN. Do not hand-edit. Entries arrive through the write gate: the autonomous agent STAGES to auto_discovered_pending.json and cannot write here; the interactive agent promotes with a human in the loop (curate-knowledge / inject-knowledge / round-housekeeping). See README.md beside this file.
_affects_convention: affects lists this model's history-variable names or the case's scored target names
